invariants.name: passed-artifact-is-complete
invariants.description: A passed artifact is valid only with a successful render and gate, raw samples, required non-null measurements, and no failure.

invariants.name: failed-artifact-keeps-evidence
invariants.description: A failed artifact may retain partial evidence but must have a structured failure and failed gate.
invariants.test_case_name: accepts a failed render artifact with partial measured evidence

invariants.name: no-fabricated-success
invariants.description: Missing telemetry, render failure, gate failure, or a non-null failure cannot be represented as passed.
invariants.test_case_name: rejects a passed artifact when required measured evidence is missing

invariants.name: workload-identity-is-pinned
invariants.description: Profile key, version, engine, dimensions, frame count, and step count are exact LTX certification literals.
invariants.test_case_name: rejects an artifact for a different workload identity

invariants.name: mode-is-explicit
invariants.description: Mode, hash, interval, memory, and counter fields accept only the explicit finite domain described by the contract.
invariants.test_case_name: rejects invalid mode hashes intervals and counters

invariants.name: selected-gpu-only

invariants.name: strict-csv

invariants.name: process-identity-is-stable

invariants.name: required-source-failure-is-loud

signature_changes.note: Adds the exported sampling service used by the certification use case.

invariants.name: start-samples-before-dispatch
invariants.description: Start resolves only after one pre-dispatch paired sample is captured.
invariants.test_case_name: captures a pre-dispatch sample before start resolves

invariants.name: one-sample-at-a-time
invariants.description: Slow sampling never overlaps another sampling attempt.
invariants.test_case_name: never overlaps telemetry reads when a sample is slow

invariants.name: sample-failure-recovers
invariants.description: A failed paired sample is recorded as an error and the next interval still runs.
invariants.test_case_name: records a sampling error and recovers on the next interval

invariants.name: stop-is-terminal
invariants.description: Stop cancels future work, drains in-flight work, and prevents later mutation.
invariants.test_case_name: drains the active sample and remains stopped

invariants.name: post-unload-is-explicit
invariants.description: The explicit post-unload sample is tagged distinctly before shutdown.
invariants.test_case_name: tags the explicit post-unload sample

invariants.name: invalid-transitions-throw
invariants.description: Invalid state machine transitions throw explicit errors while stop() is idempotent across all states.
invariants.test_case_name: rejects invalid state machine transitions and handles re-entrant calls

invariants.name: consecutive-error-budget-aborts
invariants.description: Exceeding the consecutive sampling error budget stops further polling and marks the sampler as failed.
invariants.test_case_name: aborts sampling when consecutive error budget is exceeded

tasks.title: Document hardware operation and metric semantics
Produce the Trinidad DynamicVRAM certification evidence
validation_commands: pnpm --filter render-worker exec tsx -e 'import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"; import { LtxCertificationArtifactSchema } from "@cco/contracts"; import { renderCertificationSummary } from "@cco/application"; const path = "certification/ltx-25/trinidad-rtx4090-dynamicvram-v1/result.json"; const artifact = LtxCertificationArtifactSchema.parse(JSON.parse(await readFile(path, "utf8"))); const summary = await readFile("certification/ltx-25/trinidad-rtx4090-dynamicvram-v1/summary.md", "utf8"); if (artifact.status !== "passed" || !artifact.gate.passed || summary !== renderCertificationSummary(artifact)) process.exit(1);'
